name: Head of Baron Vardus
summary: Baron Vardus’s severed head is proof that Southshore’s hunt for the former Alterac noble has reached its end. Magistrate Maleb receives it in answer to the Baron’s brutality.

sections.title: A Baron Brought Low
sections.body: The contract bearing Baron Vardus’s name leads from Southshore into the Syndicate haunts of Alterac. Vardus is a noble of the former kingdom, known for a cold heart and brutal practices. Magistrate Maleb wants him brought to justice after his thugs were sent against Southshore. The Baron’s head is the proof Maleb demands.

faq.answer: Baron Vardus was a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, known for his cold heart and brutal practices.

faq.q: Why does Southshore want his head?
faq.answer: Magistrate Maleb says Vardus sent his thugs against Southshore and wants him brought to justice.

faq.q: Where can Baron Vardus be found?
faq.answer: Vardus is among the Syndicate haunts in Alterac, perhaps at the ruins of Strahnbrad or in the valley north of them.
Magistrate Maleb in Southshore receives Baron Vardus’s head as proof that the hunt is done.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you can see Southshore seeking justice against a Syndicate noble who sent thugs against the town.
